connector.name: Lawbster
connector.registryDescription: Verified, citable German & EU law for any LLM. Daily updates from official sources, hosted in DE.
connector.summary: Hosted at lawbster.planitprima.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the planit-tech account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token in the form 'Bearer sk-legal-...'. Create an API key at https://lawbster.planitprima.com/
